definitions.meaning: Annual source-native land-cover classification, not homogeneous local exposure.

definitions.label: Welsh Phase1 habitat
definitions.meaning: Historical habitat classification; mosaic composition belongs to original surveyed mosaic, not every Voronoi cell.

version.value: retained JNCC2008 Welsh column; historical survey labels

definitions.label: Dry acid heath
definitions.meaning: Welsh Phase1 dry acid heath; native D.1.1 retains ecological meaning and survey context.

version.value: retained JNCC2008 Welsh column; historical survey labels

definitions.label: No data
definitions.meaning: Native no-data code; not evidence of physical absence.

definitions.label: Tree cover
definitions.meaning: Tree-dominated cover, at least10% tree cover; native class can include vegetation/other cover beneath canopy.

definitions.label: woody vegetation
definitions.meaning: Small retained common interpretation, not a production ontology or per-cell physical truth.

definitions.label: Shrubland
definitions.meaning: Woody perennial vegetation below5m, at least10% shrub cover; native annual classification.

definitions.label: Grassland
definitions.meaning: Herbaceous vegetation below5m and at least10% grass cover; not a specific habitat identity.

definitions.label: nonwoody vegetation
definitions.meaning: Small retained common interpretation, not a production ontology or per-cell physical truth.

definitions.label: Built-up
definitions.meaning: Buildings, roads and other human-made structures; native exclusions/thresholds in PUM table3; not land use.

definitions.label: artificial cover
definitions.meaning: Small retained common interpretation, not a production ontology or per-cell physical truth.

definitions.label: Bare / sparse vegetation
definitions.meaning: Exposed soil, sand or rocks, never exceeding10% vegetation during the year; does not distinguish bedrock, scree or soil.

definitions.label: mineral exposure with sparse vegetation
definitions.meaning: Small retained common interpretation, not a production ontology or per-cell physical truth.

definitions.label: Permanent water bodies
definitions.meaning: Water-covered areas for more than9 months of the year; not instantaneous water edge or depth.

definitions.label: persistent water cover
definitions.meaning: Small retained common interpretation, not a production ontology or per-cell physical truth.

definitions.label: Moss and lichen
definitions.meaning: Moss and lichen cover; source taxonomy/thresholds in PUM table3; not generic habitat truth.

definitions.label: Geological substrate
definitions.meaning: Material beneath the current cover; annual cover classification cannot establish it.

outside.explanation: Geographic query falls outside retained raster support; no physical absence asserted.
